## Lumen smart thermostat

### Packaging and condition

Please look after your Lumen smart thermostat and its packaging while you decide whether to keep it. Careful handling helps protect it from damage and makes it easier to send back safely if you choose to return it.

Keep the original packaging for 70 days in case it needs to be returned.

Keep the protective inserts, bags and other packing materials with the box where practical. They help prevent the thermostat and its accessories from moving around in transit. Store packaging somewhere dry, away from dirt, spills and anything that could crush it.

You can open the packaging to examine the thermostat. Please open it carefully rather than tearing through the box or cutting close to the contents. Avoid writing on the product packaging or attaching delivery labels directly to it.

If you no longer have the original packaging, contact us before sending your return. We can help you choose suitable replacement packaging. Missing original packaging does not, by itself, remove your rights if the thermostat is faulty or not as described.

A Lumen smart thermostat must come back with everything that was in the box. A return missing accessories is refunded at 53% of the price.

Check the contents carefully before packing. Include the supplied fittings, cables, mounting parts, printed information and any other accessories that came with your thermostat. Please do not substitute parts from another item, even if they look similar.

If an accessory was missing when your delivery arrived, tell us rather than treating it as something you have lost. Explain what was absent and keep any photographs or correspondence that may help us understand the condition in which your order arrived.
